description: A painting of a mosque complex under construction: several domes and at least two slender minarets, one wrapped in timber scaffolding. In the foreground a man in a turban and dark vest hauls a carved stone block up on a rope and pulley over a timber scaffold, with a second turbaned worker at right. Behind, a strait or harbour has sailing boats and a hilly city skyline under a pale sky. There is no visible lettering, number, frame or border, and the painting runs edge to edge. Nothing gory.
